name: @smart-anketa/json-logic-ts
description: Typed json-logic-js engine for Smart Anketa (V2 rules)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:dts && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && cp logic.js dist/cjs/logic.js && mv dist/cjs/index.cjs.js dist/cjs/index.js
scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && cp logic.js dist/esm/logic.js && node scripts/patch-logic-for-esm.mjs && mv dist/esm/index.esm.js dist/esm/index.js
